about_the_game:
This add-on content contains the following.

●BGM: The Village of Wind and Meadow - Bherna Village
●BGM: Awakening ~ MHG Ver.
●BGM: Pokke Village Theme ~ MHG Ver.
●BGM: Yearning for the Secret Hot Spring ~ MHG Ver.

Enjoy listening to the music from past bases, where so many have gone about their hunting lives!

*You can change music by selecting Change BGM in the Tent Settings Menu in your tent.
*Background music during quests cannot be changed
*This product is also available as part of a set.
*You may need to update to the latest version of the game to use this content.
